source_before: IC1984/85 CONTROL=2 private with profit unspecified
api_rule: Apply year-specific labels and retain raw code
interpretation: Do not treat 1984-85 private schools as private nonprofits

source_before: ICLEVEL=7 unclassified
api_rule: Map only recognized 1/2/3 levels; preserve 7 as raw code
interpretation: Early 7 is not a less-than-two-year school

source_before: UNITID 247719 shared by many different schools
source_after: No reliable unique UNITID for those records
api_rule: Return raw rows; refuse ambiguous Characteristics merge
interpretation: The 1986 file is not uniformly keyed one row per UNITID

source_before: Early blank explicitly means no in 1992-94; 1995-97 -1 means missing/nonresponse
api_rule: Use nullable booleans and retain raw *_code
interpretation: Historical nonresponse is not zero/no

source_before: Legacy 1-9 urbanization scheme
api_rule: Retain source code and attach locale_scheme
interpretation: Do not compare raw LOCALE codes across the 2005 boundary

source_before: No header coordinates before 2009
api_rule: Older years return missing coordinate fields
interpretation: Coordinate fields are strings in the current API

source_before: Earlier Carnegie vintages
api_rule: Expose a versioned 2021 code only
interpretation: Do not treat different Carnegie vintages as the same category

source_before: ENRLFTM/W and ENRLPTM/W
api_rule: In 2001 sum full-time and part-time within sex before calculating yields
interpretation: Do not identify admitted applicants as SAT/ACT score submitters

source_before: IC20xx includes admissions questions
api_rule: Use year-specific configured endpoints
interpretation: File naming changed without implying all test-score columns exist annually

source_before: Earlier totals sometimes reconstructed from men+women
source_after: ADM2024 also has another/unknown gender fields
api_rule: Use published totals when present; raw SATPCT/ACTPCT describe first-time degree/certificate-seeking score submitters
interpretation: Do not assume binary totals cover all reported genders or that SATPCT means share of admittees

source_before: Undergraduate FT/PT LINE=1 and 15
api_rule: Select the year-specific total student lines then sum by institution
interpretation: Do not sum the whole source file (subtotals duplicate students)

source_before: Graduate and first-professional LINE definitions change across 1984-2009
api_rule: Apply year-specific grad_rules from cleaners.py
interpretation: Graduate populations are not guaranteed to be definitionally identical across years

source_before: Older EFRACE## categories and Asian/Pacific grouping
api_rule: Choose one naming regime per file before aggregation
interpretation: Historical race categories are not an exact crosswalk for later categories

source_before: First-professional LSTUDY=2 separately reported
source_after: First-professional no longer separate from graduate level
api_rule: Expose first_professional only through 2010
interpretation: Old grad alone is not comparable to later graduate-including-professional counts

source_before: FYRACE20 combined Asian/Pacific Islander
api_rule: Preserve combined older column separately; never sum it with later separated columns
interpretation: These race measures are not the same time series

source_before: LSTUDY level rows
source_after: Expanded EFFYALEV nested totals and details
api_rule: Select codes 1/2/12 for total/undergrad/grad rather than sum nested rows
interpretation: The total row overlaps level rows in student_level=all

source_before: RET_PCF and RET_PCP percentages only
api_rule: Keep counts missing before 2007; retain published rate rather than recomputing
interpretation: Year denotes follow-up fall and cohort_year is prior fall

source_before: Adjusted cohort = cohort - exclusions
source_after: Study-abroad inclusions add to adjusted cohort
api_rule: Keep inclusion fields missing before first recorded 2016
interpretation: Missing does not mean a recorded zero

source_before: Separate IC*_AY / IC*_PY files
source_after: COST1_2024 combined academic and program reporters
api_rule: Separate reporter using CIPCODE1=-2 for academic in 2024
interpretation: Current price year is not the earlier prices repeated in a rolling file

source_before: IC2001_AY and IC2001_PY contain nonreporter rows
source_after: Other years generally split the populations
api_rule: Remove empty AY price rows and PY rows with CIPCODE1=-2
interpretation: Do not double-count the same institution-year

source_before: CHG1PY3 is price for entering students
source_after: CIPTUIT1 separately prices programs with no FTFT students
api_rule: Keep the two price populations in separate columns
interpretation: Do not add tuition and fees to manufacture CHG* published prices

source_before: SCFA1N/SCFA2 for academic or SCFY1N/SCFY2 for program
source_after: SCUGFFN/SCUGRAD common cohort fields when present
api_rule: Choose the matching reporter's denominator
interpretation: FTFT and all-undergraduate recipients are different populations

source_before: Early SFA federal/state/institutional grants and loans
source_after: FTFT Pell/federal loan breakdowns begin 2008; all-UG aid amounts from 2009
api_rule: Keep missing earlier years missing and preserve own subgroup denominators
interpretation: Grant recipient categories can overlap; dollar averages are per recipients not all students

source_before: SFA NPIST2 refers to aid-period average net price
source_after: COST2_2024 NPIST2 refers to 2023-24 aid year
api_rule: Left-join COST2 to SFA for year=2024 without dropping schools
interpretation: Net price is cost of attendance after qualifying grants; not tuition or a grant payment

source_before: SFAV is a separate institutional file from SFA
source_after: SFAV includes some graduate-only schools absent from SFA
api_rule: Expose it as VeteransAid instead of joining only to SFA
interpretation: Benefits are amounts known to institutions rather than every benefit a student receives

source_before: No MAJORNUM in pre-2001 A files
source_after: MAJORNUM=1 first or 2 second from C2001_A onward
api_rule: Default combines the post-2000 rows and marks earlier major_type unspecified; requested first/second before 2001 raises
interpretation: Earlier files do not prove that a major is first or second

source_before: Doctoral AWLEVEL=9
api_rule: Apply year-dependent doctoral filter and sum chosen categories within CIP
interpretation: These are awards by program and major not distinct people

source_before: Source CIP versions and code definitions change
api_rule: Attach code labels by cip AND year rather than CIP alone
interpretation: Year-specific label matching is not a cross-version CIP crosswalk

source_before: C*_B gives one unduplicated institution total
source_after: C*_C counts distinct people within each AWLEVELC
api_rule: Use B for all awards or C for award-level and age measures
interpretation: Do not sum C levels into B or combine with CIP awards from C*_A

source_before: Certificate shorter than one year uses AWLEVELC=1
api_rule: Preserve raw and normalized code with year-specific readable labels
interpretation: One short-certificate code is not an invariant award category

source_before: GRTYPE 8 cohort / 9 bachelor completers; 29/30 associate
source_after: Same GR rows filtered by SECTION=2/4 and CHRTSTAT=12/13
api_rule: Pivot cohort/graduate counts and compute rate at 150% of normal time
interpretation: Graduation cohort/status year is not annual awards or FTFT retention year
